items.name: base
items.title: P1 starter blocks
items.description: The P1 marketing and editorial block set for Puck: 29 blocks plus the P1 token layer. Installs code you own and can modify.
items.docs: Register the installed blocks in components/puck/blocks/index.ts, which your Puck config already spreads. Add more any time with `shadcn add @p1/<name>`, and review our updates to a block you have edited with `shadcn add @p1/<name> --diff`.

items.name: tokens
items.title: P1 design tokens
items.description: The P1 marketing token layer: surfaces, accent, spacing, section rhythm, radii and type scale. Values derive from Pantheon Design System v2 with literal fallbacks, so blocks render correctly with or without PDS loaded.
items.docs: Both files are yours. Override any --p1-* value in app/p1-tokens.css to retheme every block at once.

items.name: internal-btn
items.title: P1 Button primitive
items.description: Shared button element used by the P1 marketing blocks. Tone, size and variant are data attributes.

items.name: internal-icons
items.title: P1 inline icons
items.description: Inline SVG icons used by the P1 marketing blocks. Size and colour are inherited from CSS.

items.name: internal-rich
items.title: P1 rich text wrapper
items.description: Prose typography wrapper used by the P1 editorial blocks, replacing Tailwind's prose classes.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable list of title/body items with a section heading; use for collapsible content like FAQs or grouped details.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: Slim banner strip with a text message and optional link label in themed tones (purple/yellow/dark/gradient); use for site-wide notices.

items.name: article-header
items.title: Article Header
items.description: Blog/article masthead with category, title, standfirst, author avatar, date, and read-time; use at the top of editorial pages.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Single CTA button (primary/secondary/yellow/purple) centered or left-aligned; use to place a standalone call-to-action.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Highlighted aside box with an icon, title, and body text in note/info/tip/warning variants; use to flag important inline content.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: Responsive 2–4 column grid of image+title+subtitle cards with an optional section heading; use for feature or product showcases.

items.name: columns
items.title: Columns
items.description: Drag-and-drop layout grid of 2–4 columns with configurable ratio, gap, and vertical alignment; use as a layout wrapper for other blocks.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: Feature comparison table with up to 4 named columns and checkmark/text rows; use for pricing or product capability comparisons.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: Constrained-width wrapper slot with tone, padding, radius, and max-width controls; use to scope and style groups of nested blocks.

items.name: cta
items.title: CTA Banner
items.description: Full-width call-to-action banner with eyebrow, title, subtitle, and up to two buttons in multiple tones and layouts; use for conversion sections.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Horizontal rule in solid, dashed, or dot styles with configurable vertical spacing; use to visually separate page sections.

items.name: embed
items.title: Embed
items.description: Responsive iframe embed for video (YouTube/Vimeo/Wistia), social posts, maps, or generic URLs with aspect-ratio and caption; use for media embeds.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Vertically stacked question-and-answer list with a section heading and icon-decorated rows; use for support or product FAQ sections.

items.name: feature-media
items.title: Feature Media
items.description: Side-by-side text+image block with eyebrow, title, body, bullet points, and a CTA button; use for product feature highlights.

items.name: features
items.title: Feature Cards
items.description: Grid of 2–4 feature cards each with eyebrow, title, and body in multiple color schemes and card styles; use for feature lists or benefit grids.

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: Single image with optional caption and photo credit, supporting aspect ratio, width, radius, and b&w treatment; use for editorial images.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Site footer with logo, tagline, multi-column link groups, newsletter signup, social icons, and legal/copyright row in dark/indigo/light tones.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: Multi-image display in grid, masonry, filmstrip, or carousel layout with optional captions and configurable columns/gap/ratio; use for photo galleries.

items.name: header
items.title: Header
items.description: Site navigation bar with logo, nav links, optional search, and a CTA button in white/light/dark tones; use as the page header/navbar.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Single H1–H4 heading element with left/center alignment; use to add a standalone section title.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Large page hero with eyebrow, title, description, two CTA buttons, and an image in split/full-image/text-only layouts with overlay options.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: Simple full-bleed or contained image block with aspect ratio, fit, position, radius, and b&w treatment controls; use for standalone images.

items.name: lead-capture
items.title: Lead Capture
items.description: Email capture section with heading, subtitle, placeholder text, a submit button, and a note field in inline or stacked layout; use for newsletter/lead forms.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Bullet, numbered, or checkmark list of text items; use for simple inline content lists.

items.name: logos
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Logo cloud row/grid of partner or customer logos in mono or color style with optional heading; use for social-proof or partner sections.

items.name: paragraph
items.title: Paragraph
items.description: Rich-text paragraph in body or lead style with size and alignment controls; use for body copy blocks.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Pricing tier cards with name, price, period, feature list, and CTA button, supporting a featured/highlighted tier; use for pricing pages.

items.name: pull-quote
items.title: Pull Quote
items.description: Large typographic blockquote with optional yellow rule or quotation mark accent and attribution; use for editorial emphasis quotes.

items.name: quote
items.title: Quote
items.description: Simple blockquote with rich-text quote and an attribution line in standard or display scale; use for inline quotations.

items.name: rich-text
items.title: Rich Text
items.description: Free-form rich-text editor output with configurable measure, size, and optional drop cap; use for long-form article body content.

items.name: spacer
items.title: Spacer
items.description: Invisible vertical whitespace element in xs–xl sizes; use to add breathing room between blocks.

items.name: stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: Horizontal grid of large value+label stat items in light or dark tone; use for key metrics or social-proof numbers.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Numbered sequential steps with eyebrow, heading, and title+body per step in a 1–4 column layout; use for how-it-works or onboarding flows.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed content switcher with a heading and per-tab rich-text body; use to organize related content into switchable panels.

items.name: team-grid
items.title: Team Grid
items.description: Grid of team member cards with avatar, name, role, and bio in circle or rounded photo shape; use for About/Team pages.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: Customer testimonial with quote text, name, role, and avatar in centered/card/large layouts and multiple tones; use for social proof.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical or alternating chronological list of date+title+body events; use for company history, product roadmaps, or process timelines.
